title: authzcov probe plan (plan_version 1)
description: Probe plan written by `authzcov export --plan`: the required-but-missing endpoint x relationship cells of a coverage.json, each with a suggested attacker identity NAME (never a credential) and the object to address. contains_raw_ids is true only when the plan was built with --har; such a file is written only to a 0600 file (--out) and must never be committed. Informational schema: authzcov builds the document in Go.

generated_at.description: When the plan was written (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH honoured).

coverage_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the coverage.json file the plan was derived from.

contains_raw_ids.description: true when any probe may carry a raw object.id. Never commit such a plan.

probes.description: Sorted by endpoint ID, then relationship in model order (owner, same_role_other_user, lower_role, higher_role, other_tenant, anonymous), then attacker identity.

oneOf.description: No identity with this relationship was seen; see note.

expect.description: deny: the request must be refused. allow: the request must succeed. policy: the application's policy decides; record the outcome.

path_params.description: Values for path parameters other than the object's, currently the tenant parameters (only with --har).

waived.description: The gap is waived; present only with --include waived.

param.description: Path parameter that carries the object ID.

id_hash.description: First 8 hex of SHA-256 of "resource/id", as in coverage.json.

owner.description: Identity name that owns the object.
